upstream.description: Governed, pro-code agentic development for Microsoft Dataverse: eleven AI SDLC gates mechanically refuse ungated Power Platform output, with a structural diff engine, an auditable refusal ledger, and six receipted golden imports.

classification.analysis: DVerse is a governed AI-SDLC harness for building Microsoft Dataverse / Power Platform solutions with AI agents: eleven code-enforced verification gates mechanically refuse ungated declarative artifacts (solution XML, FormXML, canvas app YAML) before they ship, backed by a structural diff engine, an append-only refusal ledger, and receipted golden imports into a live Dataverse environment. It targets Power Platform architects and AI-SDLC practitioners who want machine-enforced governance over AI-generated low-code output rather than human review. Built in C# with GitHub Actions CI (offline and online gate tiers) and a companion `dv-architect` Claude Code skill that encodes every burned lesson as a citable rule.

use_cases.title: Mechanically block AI-generated Dataverse solutions that break platform rules before import
Diff two versions of a Power Platform solution tree and refuse silent structural changes
Give an AI coding agent a domain skill so it builds plugins and canvas apps under enforced Dataverse rules
Run offline/online CI gates over Power Platform artifacts on every PR with zero stored credentials
